Import trees from the GoM assessment form spreadsheets
need to adjust to include block id as column in tree data
And then turn function such that it reads through all spreadsheets in a folder
```{r}
process_excel_folder_recursive <- function(folder_path, target_values = c("NW", "N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W")) {
  # Get all Excel files in the folder and subfolders
  file_list <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
    # file_list = "./assessments_clean/2025/JohnPrestmo/GoM_AssessmentForm1.xlsx"
  # Initialize an empty list to store processed data
  all_data <- list()
#file_path = "./raw_data/Smithers Assessments/mcdonnell_k2p_aa_10.xlsx"
  # Loop through each file
  for (file_path in file_list) {
    # Read the Block_ID from the "Block info" sheet (cell B2)
    # file_path = "./assessments_clean/2025/JohnPrestmo/GoM_AssessmentForm1.xlsx"
    sheets <- excel_sheets(file_path)
    if ("Block info" %in% sheets) {
  Block_ID <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Block info", range = "B1", col_names = FALSE)[[1]]
  
  # Skip file if Block_ID is missing or blank
  if (is.na(Block_ID) || Block_ID == "") {
    Block_ID <- "needs_block_id"
    next
  }
  
  Block_lat <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Block info", range = "B3", col_names = FALSE)[[1]]
  Block_long <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Block info", range = "B4", col_names = FALSE)[[1]]
  Planted_year <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Block info", range = "B5", col_names = FALSE)[[1]]
} else {
  cat("Skipping file due to missing 'Block info' sheet:", file_path, "\n")
  next
}
# 
#     if ("Block info" %in% sheets) {
#       Block_ID <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Block info", range = "B1", col_names = FALSE)[[1]]
#       Block_lat <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Block info", range = "B3", col_names = FALSE)[[1]]
#       Block_long <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Block info", range = "B4", col_names = FALSE)[[1]]
#       Planted_year <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Block info", range = "B5", col_names = FALSE)[[1]]
#       
#     } else {
#       Block_ID <- NA  # If "Block info" sheet is missing, assign NA
# 
#     }
  # Print Block_ID for each file
    cat("Processing file:", file_path, "\nBlock_ID:", Block_ID, "\n")
#sheet_name = "Fd"
    # Function to check if the first cell (A1) contains a target value
filter_sheets <- function(sheet_name) {
  first_cell <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = sheet_name, range = "A1", col_names = FALSE)
  first_value <- toupper(first_cell[[1]])  # Convert to uppercase
  return(!is.na(first_value) && first_value %in% target_values)
}
    # Filter sheets based on A1 contents and remove unwanted sheets
    valid_sheets <- Filter(filter_sheets, sheets)
    valid_sheets <- valid_sheets[!valid_sheets %in% c("BlankSppAssessment", "AssessmentCodesDefs", "TrialAssessmentCodesDefs", "TreeAssessmentCodesDefs", "Export Summary")]
    # remove any sheets that begin with "Spp"
    valid_sheets <- valid_sheets[!grepl("^Spp", valid_sheets)]
    valid_sheets <- valid_sheets[!grepl("^Sheet", valid_sheets)]
    # Import valid sheets and read the desired range
    data_list <- lapply(valid_sheets, function(sheet) {
      df <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = sheet, range = "B2:F6", col_names = FALSE)
      df_long <- df %>%
        pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "value") %>%
        filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
        mutate(Block_ID = as.character(Block_ID),# Add Block_ID from "Block info" sheet
               Block_lat = as.numeric(Block_lat),
               Block_long = as.numeric(Block_long),
               Planted_year = as.numeric(Planted_year),
               species = sheet,  # Add sheet name
               vigour = substr(value, 1, 1),
               notes = substr(value, 2, nchar(value))) %>%
        dplyr::select(Block_ID, Planted_year, Block_lat, Block_long, species, vigour, notes)
              #select(Block_ID, species, vigour, notes)
      return(df_long)
    })

    # Combine data from current file and store in the list
    all_data <- append(all_data, data_list)
  }

  # Combine all processed data across multiple files and subfolders
  Trees <- bind_rows(all_data)

  # Print results
  print(Trees)

  return(Trees)
}

# Usage example
folder_path <- "./assessments_clean/2025/JohnPrestmo/"
#folder_path <- "./raw_data/2025/EricPollack_Kalum/"
Trees <- process_excel_folder_recursive(folder_path)

Trees2 <- Trees %>%
  mutate(
    species_code = sub("[^A-Za-z].*", "", species),
    replicate_raw = sub("^[A-Za-z]+", "", species),
    replicate_clean = gsub("[()-]", "", replicate_raw),
    replicate = as.numeric(replicate_clean),
    replicate = ifelse(is.na(replicate), 1, replicate), 
    species = species_code
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-replicate_raw, -replicate_clean, -species_code) %>% 
  mutate(species = recode(species, 'Fdi' = "Fd"))

trial_many_missed <- Trees2 %>% 
       mutate(missed = ifelse(is.na(vigour) | vigour == "M", 1, 0)) %>% 
    group_by(Block_ID, Planted_year, species, replicate) %>%
  summarize(total = n(), missed = sum(missed), percent_missed = missed/total)

blocks <- Trees2 %>% distinct(Block_ID) %>% nrow()
trials <- Trees2 %>% distinct(Block_ID, species) %>% nrow()

fwrite(Trees2, "./clean_data/GoM_assessed_trees_2023_24_Prestmo.csv")
```

Summary across trial
```{r}
Trees2 <-  fread("./clean_data/GoM_assessed_trees_2023_24.csv")
Trees.new <-  fread("./clean_data/GoM_assessed_trees_2023_24_Prestmo.csv")
Trees2 <- rbind(Trees2, Trees.new) %>% distinct
# Count of unique Block_IDs
no_blocks_assessed <- Trees2 %>%
  distinct(Block_ID) %>%
  nrow()
# Count of unique Block_IDs + species
assessed <- Trees2 %>% 
  mutate(
    vigour_value = case_when(
      vigour == "P" ~ 1,
      vigour == "F" ~ 2,
      vigour == "G" ~ 3,
      vigour == "E" ~ 4,
      vigour == "D" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    survival = ifelse(vigour_value <= 1, 0, 1)
  ) %>%
   filter(!is.na(vigour_value)) %>%
  group_by(Block_ID, Planted_year, Block_lat, Block_long, species, replicate) %>%
  summarize(count = n(), mean_vig = mean(vigour_value), survival = (sum(survival)/count), .groups = "drop") %>% group_by(Block_ID, Planted_year, Block_lat, Block_long, species) %>% slice_max(mean_vig, n=1) %>% ungroup %>%
  mutate(performance = ifelse(mean_vig >= 3.5, "Excellent", 
                              ifelse(mean_vig >= 2.5, "Good", 
                                     ifelse(mean_vig >= 1.5, "Fair", 
                                            ifelse(mean_vig >= 0.5, "Poor", 
                                                   ifelse(mean_vig < 0.5, "Fail", "Fail")))))) %>% 
  mutate(species = recode(species, 'Fdi' = "Fd"))

fwrite(assessed, "./clean_data/GoM_assessed_trials_2023_24.csv")
```
add in Hardy casual surveys
```{r}
hardy.surveys <- fread("./assessments_clean/2025/Hardy_All_Simple_Survey.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    longitude = ifelse(longitude < 0, longitude, -longitude),
    latitude = latitude,
    PlotNumber = PlotNumber,
    species = species,
    year_established = year(ymd(date_established)),
    replicate = 1,
    mean_vig = NA
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Block_ID = PlotNumber, Planted_year = year_established, Block_lat =latitude, Block_long = longitude,  species = species, replicate, count, mean_vig, survival, performance) %>% filter(!performance %in% c("Missing"))
assessed2 <- rbind(assessed, hardy.surveys) %>% distinct
fwrite(assessed2, "./clean_data/GoM_assessed_trials_2023_24.csv")
```

add annual climr data BGC to assessed.gom.trials
``` {r}
gom.trials <- fread("./clean_data/GoM_assessed_trials_2023_24.csv") %>% rename(longitude = Block_long, latitude = Block_lat, species = species, PlotNumber = Block_ID)

plot.loc = gom.trials
plot_locations <- st_as_sf(plot.loc, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4269)
plot_locations <- st_transform(plot_locations, 3005)
st_crs(plot_locations) <- 3005
elevation <- terra::rast("D:/OneDrive - Government of BC/CommonTables/DEMs/BC_25m_DEM.tif")
elevation.pts <- terra::extract(elevation, plot_locations, bind = TRUE) %>% as.data.frame
gom.trials2 <- left_join(as.data.frame(gom.trials), elevation.pts) %>% dplyr::mutate(id = row_number())%>%
  dplyr::select(PlotNumber, species, performance, longitude, latitude, elevation = BC_25m_DEM, id, everything())
my_points <- gom.trials2 %>% dplyr::select(lat = latitude, lon=longitude, elev = elevation, id) %>% na.omit %>% as.data.table
tic()
clim_dat <- downscale(
  xyz = my_points, 
  return_refperiod = TRUE,
  obs_years = 2023:2024,
  obs_ts_data = "cru.gpcc",
 vars=list_vars())
toc()
gom.climate2 <- left_join(gom.trials2, clim_dat)

bgc <- st_read("D:/OneDrive - Government of BC/BECdb_Working/BECv13_for_checkin/BGCv13_7_final.gpkg", crs = 3005)
st_crs(bgc) <- 3005
# Transform tree points to match BGC CRS for spatial join
# Save original lat/lon before converting to sf
gom.climate2 <- gom.climate2 %>%
  mutate(orig_latitude = latitude, orig_longitude = longitude)

# Convert to sf and transform CRS
gom.sf <- st_as_sf(gom.climate2, coords = c("orig_longitude", "orig_latitude"), crs = 4269)
gom.sf <- st_transform(gom.sf, crs = 3005)

# Join BGC info
gom.sf <- st_join(gom.sf, bgc["BGC"]) %>%
  mutate(BGC = as.factor(BGC))

# Drop geometry but retain original lat/lon
gom.climate2 <- gom.sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Write to CSV
fwrite(gom.climate2, "./clean_data/GoM_assessed_climate.csv")


```
